facts.fact: Tamsin 坐在自家车里抬头看那栋小屋，反复看出对称：两扇前门只隔一英尺多一点
facts.anchor: I sat in the driver’s seat of my car staring up at the house

facts.fact: 她翻出车里合同照片，才发现地址是 1b——半独立，她只看照片没实地看房就签了
facts.anchor: When I saw the 1b on the form, I’d assumed it was a contract thing.

facts.fact: 1a 那半的草坪疯长，1b 这半被草草割过（她猜是中介为拍房源照）
facts.anchor: the lawn on 1a’s side of the mound was wildly overgrown

facts.fact: 1a 楼上窗户的浅色花纹窗帘突然被拉紧，她判断是手不是风
facts.anchor: A pale, patterned curtain was suddenly pulled tight.

facts.fact: 她攥紧房源单，指节发白，纸的折痕压进掌心
facts.anchor: I’d scrunched the listing into a tight ball, my knuckles white

facts.fact: 警方联系人给她安排了心理咨询，并明确说这不是建议；她认为自己不需要
facts.anchor: They’d made it very clear that it wasn’t a suggestion.

facts.fact: 门上新换的 Yale 锁四周有深划痕，她猜是撬开前任住户留下的
facts.anchor: they’d failed to hide the deep scratches in the woodwork all around the edge

facts.fact: 一楼窗帘又抽动一下；她自问也许警察说得对，也许自己疯了
facts.anchor: Maybe the police were right. Maybe I was crazy.
